audit_kind: DELTA audit of the 27 keys this branch adds or changes across ui.settings.shortcuts (13), ui.chat.composer (8) and ui.chat.canonical (6), read on the MERGED catalogue bytes. Not a full-file audit and not a human review: every other key of these three files is byte-identical to one of the two audited parents (catalogue-union-parity: no value differences), so their audits stand in the superseded rows.
independence: A different agent and model family from the translators (anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5, self-reported). The coder that assembled this receipt neither translated nor audited. Same-lane corrections before this audit: es and fr keycap names made consistent with origin/main (es Enter->Intro in 13 strings; fr (Enter) -> (Entrée) and Esc -> Échap in the two steer hints), after a first pass found them MAJOR against the established vocabulary; round 1 for es/fr had been run with a prompt that wrongly demanded English keycaps and its findings on that point were discarded.

findings.message: “قطار، پھر ہدایت بھیجیں” can read as sending a queue and then an instruction, rather than naming the combined delivery mode.
findings.suggested: قطار کے طور پر، پھر ہدایت کے طور پر بھیجیں
findings.disposition: recorded, not churned: minor/nit only; no blocker or major

findings.message: “ہدایت دیں” is an imperative (“give direction”) quoted as though it were the steer mode name, unlike the consistent noun “ہدایت” elsewhere.
findings.suggested: مصروف ہونے پر ترسیل تبدیل نہیں ہو سکتی، اس لیے پیغام نہیں بھیجا گیا۔ اسے ہدایت کے طور پر بھیجیں، یا بیک اینڈ اپ ڈیٹ کریں۔
findings.disposition: recorded, not churned: minor/nit only; no blocker or major

findings.message: “چلتا ٹول” is unnatural Urdu for “a running tool.”
findings.suggested: ہدایت — چلتا ہوا ٹول رک سکتا ہے
findings.disposition: recorded, not churned: minor/nit only; no blocker or major

notes: No blocking meaning, placeholder, product-name, keycap-consistency, or bidi defects found.
